items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Well, that one died out there by the name of Albert, George.

ctx.x: Well, did you know them up there too, the Giles?
Well, I know him from Thibodeau. I was a little kid. Well, that one died out there by the name of Albert, George.
Yeah, there were several of them, yeah.
